items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Lou Singer, who happened to be working at Leeds (Music)... So we had a relationship there. He dug up some material and got together for this date... Lou Singer was not only doing a little research for me picking up these numbers, he also did the arrangements too.

ctx.x: -- on tape, and I was asking Maxine Sullivan about the August 22, 1939 session in which Alec Wilder was involved.

Yeah. I think I mentioned the fact that, by this time Claude and I were no longer working together. And I had to sort of look around and find somebody of the same caliber to help me with selection of material, and also making the arrangements. Lou Singer, who happened to be working at Leeds (Music), you know, doing the transcriptions -- he had also made arrangements for John Kirby Orchestra. So we had a relationship there. He dug up some material and got together for this date, and Alec Wilder made the…
Yeah. Didn't he also write, 'If I had A Ribbon Bow'?
